title: AggregateConnector
description: Groups rows by columns and aggregates fact columns (sum, count, average); optional sort

sourceConnectorName.title: Source connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Upstream connector this transform reads from (if applicable)

cacheOnDisk.title: Cache data on disk?
cacheOnDisk.description: Store connector output as Hop binary rows under the server data path. Reloads only when the connector changes or a full presentation refresh is requested.

groupColumns.title: Group columns
groupColumns.description: Columns that define the aggregation groups (like dimensions on a chart)

aggregates.title: Aggregate columns
aggregates.description: Fact columns with aggregation method (SUM, COUNT, AVERAGE) — same idea as chart facts

sortByGroupFields.title: Sort by group fields
sortByGroupFields.description: When checked, sort the aggregated rows in memory by the group column values
